topic: India sweeps T20 series against Zimbabwe
headline: INDIA SWEEPS T20 SERIES AGAINST ZIMBABWE, WINS ALL 5 MATCHES TO EXTEND THEIR DOMINANCE
summary: India has swept the T20 series against Zimbabwe, winning all five Twenty20 International matches. The Indian cricket team toured Zimbabwe in July 2024 to play the series. Although the exact details of the matches are not provided, India's victory in the series is confirmed. The team had previously shown strong performance in other cricket matches, including defending their T20 World Cup title. India is currently ranked as the number one team in T20 rankings.
